scope: Module-private bootstrap-to-exchange configuration persistence primitive, native filesystem adapters, and fail-closed existing bootstrap validation. Install is called only by tests; no controller/helper install operation or exchange-mode process launch is exposed.

contract.authority: Every install/recovery recompiles bootstrap and verifies derived binding against the caller's current borrowed ExchangeConfigPolicy. The journal cannot create trust or substitute for future original native identity/certificate/OS-credential and runtime admission checks.
contract.journal: Schema1, exact native-home path, bootstrap, desired config and binding, pending/committed phase. Native private data only, including the native REST credential already required in config.xml; never canonical data, Debug output, logs or exported diagnostics.
contract.bounds: 256 KiB config, 64 KiB binding, 1 MiB journal, 4096-byte UTF8 native-home path; reject duplicate/unknown JSON fields and unknown schema.
contract.staging: Only the exact next replacement can have a complete stage. Partial, foreign, multiple or out-of-order stages and all committed-stage leftovers refuse without silently deleting or repairing them.
contract.commit: Pending journal, config, binding, committed journal; each replacement has bounded readback. Both new commit and unchanged committed retry renew all fixed-leaf flush barriers and read back exact bytes/no stages. No canonical append or delete.
contract.windows: Private owner ACL validation, original no-delete-sharing ancestor pins, exact-stage resumption, MoveFileExW REPLACE_EXISTING|WRITE_THROUGH, writable-file flushing and installed file identity/readback checks.
contract.mac: Private owner/ACL/nlink checks; original ancestor-to-child edge validation; descriptor-relative openat/renameat; file fsync/F_FULLFSYNC, parent fsync and installed inode/readback checks. Existing retained ancestors are reused rather than duplicated.
contract.bootstrap: Existing PreparedNativeProfile validation refuses any exchange binding/journal/stage, including empty files, before native identity/credential validation. No recovery or activation through the old path.
